name: RedLurk
tagline: RedLurk helps founders, indie hackers, and app developers find potential customers on Reddit - without spamming or getting banned
description: RedLurk helps founders, indie hackers, and app developers find potential customers on Reddit - without spamming or getting banned. You describe your product, and RedLurk identifies the most relevant subreddits where your target audience is already talking. It then scrapes the last 7 days of posts across up to 10 communities and surfaces the 8–10 threads where someone is actively describing the exact problem your product solves. Every matched thread comes with a contextually written draft reply,
